source: Chris Diet Hub update: 2850–2900 weekly, 140P, 65–70F, 4 meals both days

profile.name: Chris
profile.goal: lean bulk — muscle with as little fat as possible

targets.leanBulkNote: Weekly average 2,850–2,900. Train a little higher, rest a little lower. 140 g protein every day. Fat 65–70 g. Remaining calories from carbs.
targets.scaleRule: Weigh 3–4 mornings/week. Goal +0.25–0.5 lb/week. Flat after 2 weeks → add 80 g cooked rice pre-lift (train) or 100 g cooked diced potato (rest). Faster than 0.5 lb/week → cut the same amount.

rules: 4 meals every day — train and rest.
Fat 65–70 g. Remaining calories from carbs.
Train: fast carbs (jasmine rice + coconut water) timed pre-lift and post-lift. No potatoes on lift days.
Rest: slow carbs (diced potatoes) at lunch, afternoon, and dinner. Smoothie in the morning. No rice.
Chicken breast is the main train-day protein. 93/7 ground beef is the main rest-day protein.
Weights for chicken, beef, rice, and potato are cooked unless you log uncooked.
Raw milk means unpasteurized, not uncooked.
No greens. Salt food. Cook eggs/beef in a little olive oil — don't drown it.
Grocery haul: pick the ground-beef fat % you actually bought (default 93/7).

train.label: Train day
train.role: surplus — jasmine rice pre-lift and post-lift, chicken at midday, 4 meals

meals.name: Morning
meals.food: 4 farm eggs cooked in ½ tbsp olive oil + 250 ml raw milk

meals.name: Midday
meals.food: 180 g cooked chicken breast + 330 ml coconut water

meals.name: Post-lift
meals.food: 650 g cooked jasmine rice + 40 g cooked 93/7 ground beef + 1 tbsp olive oil

rest.label: Rest day
rest.role: slightly lower carb — smoothie plus diced potatoes at the other 3 meals, 4 meals

meals.name: Morning smoothie
meals.food: 300 ml raw milk + 1 banana + 1 cup frozen berries

meals.name: Lunch
meals.food: 125 g cooked 93/7 ground beef + 2 farm eggs + 500 g cooked diced potato

meals.name: Afternoon
meals.food: 600 g cooked diced potato + 250 ml coconut water + 200 ml raw milk

meals.name: Dinner
meals.food: 125 g cooked 93/7 ground beef + 2 farm eggs + 500 g cooked diced potato + ½ tbsp olive oil

prep.rice: 7,250 g cooked jasmine rice / week (5 × 800 g pre + 5 × 650 g post) ≈ 5.3 lb dry
prep.potato: 3,200 g cooked diced potato / week (2 rest days × 1,600 g) ≈ 9–10 lb raw
prep.chicken: 900 g cooked / week (180 g × 5) from ~3 lb raw
prep.beef: 700 g cooked 93/7 / week (40 g × 5 train + 250 g × 2 rest) from ~2.5 lb raw

covered: potassium from potato + coconut water + banana
watch: Magnesium a bit lighter with no greens
micros.notes: Rest-day beef carries zinc/iron/B12. Potatoes and coconut water cover potassium. Salt food. Don't get leaner than ~11–13% while bulking.
